description: Vet ONE creator across ALL their accounts in a single call — the cross-platform view a brand signs off on before a deal. Provide the creator's handles across platforms and it returns: the UNIFIED CreatorScore (the official cross-platform FICO when the accounts are linked/monitored, otherwise a clearly-labeled follower-weighted estimate from the accounts we could read), the per-platform breakdown, and the worst risk flags found on ANY account. CACHED-ONLY and safe: it never scrapes. Accounts with no recent score come back as 'not scored' (no charge) — score those gaps with score_creator_fresh to fold them in. Each already-scored account costs 1 credit. Use this whenever someone wants to vet a creator 'everywhere' / 'across all their accounts'.

creators.description: The SAME creator's accounts across platforms, e.g. [{platform:'tiktok',handle:'x'},{platform:'instagram',handle:'x'}].

name: vet_creator
